verdict.rationale: The pack never mentions an in-product universal search bar. The closest match is through external AI tools via Ramp MCP or the CLI: agents can search transactions by merchant, amount, date, or user, load vendor lists, query cards and balances, and take actions including bill writes. That is a natural-language substitute requiring extra tools, not a single search bar that jumps into payment initiation. Missing for 10: a documented in-app universal search bar spanning transactions, vendors and cards; a direct search-to-payment flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.
